title: GMI theme-graph evidence row v1
description: One ROW of data/theme_graph/evidence.parquet, as a JSON object. Masterplan §4.1. Receipt rows an edge's evidence_refs point at. Every row is DATED (published_at) — that is what makes the semantic-leakage law checkable: an edge whose evidence cannot be dated is knowledge from nowhere, and the guard refuses it. Contradictory and corroborating evidence coexist as separate rows; nothing nets, nothing is superseded in place. Licensing tags travel with the receipt so a display surface can ask whether it may show, and a redistribution path whether it may republish, without re-deriving the answer from the source.

evidence_id.description: Deterministic: 'ev:' + sha1(kind|source_ref|published_at)[:16] — the same receipt observed twice is one row.

published_at.description: When the source document/observation was published. REQUIRED and dated — an undatable receipt is not evidence here.

effective_at.description: When the underlying reality took effect, where it lags publication (memo §206). Null when publication IS the event.

source_ref.description: Repo path, accession, URL or url-hash identifying the source.

licensing_internal_ok.description: May be used in internal computation.

licensing_display_ok.description: May be shown to a user.

licensing_redistribution_ok.description: May be republished as a dataset. Vendor-derived rows are false here.

retention.description: Retention constraint carried by the source, when it has one; null when unconstrained.
